josh-recruiter: Heads-up — Offer accepted for Priya K. Looking to confirm sign-on mechanics + benefits timing for a 2026-04-01 payroll start. Candidate wants to do onboarding tasks earlier (3/22). Need clarity on pension auto-enroll, stock proration, and whether we can offer a short bridge stipend. cc @sarah-people-ops @legal-escalations
people-ops-bot: New offer submitted: req#12345. Link: https://people-portal.internal/offers/12345 
people-ops-bot: ```offer_summary:
 name: Priya K
 start_date_requested: 2026-04-01
 location: UK-remote
 sign_on_amount_requested: GBP 6,000
 payroll_entity: Redwood UK Ltd```
sarah-people-ops: Quick clarifying Q — confirm payroll entity is Redwood UK and candidate has UK right-to-work?
josh-recruiter: Yes, payroll Redwood UK. Candidate sent in passport + BRP, verified. Right-to-work ok. They want to start product training earlier but payroll start = 4/1.
benefits-team: For UK hires we auto-enroll into pension after the first full pay period following payroll start. Bridge stipend or provisional uplift is not automatic; requires comp-exception approval and budget sign-off. See policy: https://hr-policy.internal/uk-pensions (section 2.3)
legal-escalations: Two asks from legal side: 1) confirm the offer language covers unpaid preboarding (if candidate does training before payroll) 2) any sign-on above GBP 5k must be routed to comp-committee. Please attach the final offer doc here.
maria-chen: We can do a provisional bridge stipend pattern (one-off) but we need manager + finance + legal signoff. Suggest wording: "preboarding stipend paid as a one-time taxable payment upon completion of onboarding tasks" — keeps benefits start tied to payroll start.
finance-ops: Finance note — RSU grant effective date must match payroll start for pro-ration calculations. If payroll start = 2026-04-01, grant proration will be monthly pro-rata from that date. If you want full grant, payroll start needs to be the official start. We can process a one-off sign-on payment outside payroll if approved.
sarah-people-ops: Plan of action: I'll open a comp-exception route: route order = hiring manager -> finance -> legal -> comp-committee (if over threshold). I'll include the offer doc and benefits packet. ETA to route by EOD today.
josh-recruiter: Thx. Two small asks: 1) can we mark preboarding as unpaid in offer while making bridge stipend contingent on completion? 2) can we get a fast-track for comp-exception (candidate's last day at current employer is 3/31).
legal-escalations: We can clear the unpaid preboarding clause; please use clause template `preboarding_unpaid_v2` from the templates repo. Fast-track ok but we need manager and finance approvals first.
sarah-people-ops: Done — created ticket PEOPLE-12345 and routed approvals. 
people-ops-bot: Ticket PEOPLE-12345 updated: comp-exception routed to hiring-manager (R&D) at 1799123468, then to finance at 1799123492.
josh-recruiter: Great — please ping once comp + finance signoff done and I'll notify candidate. :thumbsup:
people-ops-bot: Final update: comp-exception approved by manager at 1799123520, awaiting finance approval.
